description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Triple Sphere Mode II (Ice, Lightning, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wisdom Mode I (Lulu)] and [Ice/Water/Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Triple Sphere Mode II (Ice, Lightning, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning/Water ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Wisdom Mode I (Lulu)
description.text: Ice, Water and Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice, Water and Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Ice, Water and Lightning abilities after using 1/2/3+ Ice, Water and Lightning abilities

description.name: Ice/Water/Lightning Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Ice, Water and Lightning abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Buff Ice 30% (5s)], [Buff Lightning 30% (5s)], [Buff Water 30% (5s)], [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wisdom Mode II (Lulu)], removes [Dual Awoken Wisdom Mode I (Lulu)]
